description.value: Karma Lounge is an upscale hotel lobby lounge located in the Paradox Hotel in downtown Vancouver, offering West Coast-inspired share plates made entirely from scratch using fresh, local, and sustainable ingredients. The space is designed as a hybrid destination — welcoming guests for lunch, cocktails, and weekend brunch before transitioning into a high-energy social venue in the evenings. It is operated by After Dark Hospitality Group and draws a mix of business professionals, local socialites, and international visitors.
